column3: “the boy” renders “the lad”; “hands” renders the Hebrew singular “hand.”
“entreated” renders “prayed to”; “O Lord” renders “Pardon me, O Lord.”
“the other day” renders “on the day”; “appeared to me” renders “presented himself to me.”
“mode of life and his vocation” renders “manner … and his work.”
“Let the woman pay attention” renders “She will take care.”
NASB omits “of the wine” after “the vine.”
“a kid” renders “a kid of the goats.”
“What is your name” renders “Who is your name.”
“He performed wonders” renders “and one acting wondrously,” whose subject is not named.
